configuration.neuron: start: v+=0.015625; groups: v+=(-v/32); threshold: v>1; reset: v=0
configuration.pre: decay both traces; v_post+=w/16; Apre+=.0078125; w=clip(w+Apost,0,.5); lastupdate=t
configuration.post: decay both traces; Apost-=.00390625; w=clip(w+Apre,0,.5); lastupdate=t
configuration.recording: all spikes; final v,w,Apre,Apost,lastupdate; start v after drive of neurons 0,N-1 every tick
